# Sigma

> Sigma is a source-available conditional inference tree library distributed
> by ArsChitectura SAS under the Sigma License (broad commercial use
> permitted with attribution + at-will revocation; AI ingestion / training /
> replication prohibited).

## License and AI training reservation

Use of any part of the Sigma library, its source code, documentation, or
related artefacts as input to, training data for, fine-tuning data for,
evaluation data for, retrieval-augmentation data for, or any other input
to any AI System is **prohibited** by Section 7 of the Sigma Source
License.

This `llms.txt` is a precautionary candidate signal under the EU AI Act
Code of Practice (the Code names `robots.txt` (RFC 9309) unconditionally
and accepts other formats - including this one - only conditionally on
standardization-body adoption or "state-of-the-art" status). Operators
of general-purpose AI models within the meaning of EU Regulation
2024/1689 art. 3(63) (AI Act) must respect the rightsholder reservation
expressed here, in conjunction with the machine-readable signals at:

- `/.well-known/tdmrep.json` (W3C TDM Reservation Protocol)
- `/ai.txt` (Spawning.ai opt-out)
- `/robots.txt` (Robot Exclusion Protocol, RFC 9309)
- the License text at `/LICENSE.txt`

The substantive obligations under AI Act Article 53(1)(c) apply from
**2 August 2025**; AI Office enforcement powers begin **2 August 2026**
(per AI Act Article 113(b)).
